title: Count local steps and guidance frequency on generator runs
narrative: Operators need to see how often a frontier driver was asked for advice versus how much local work ran, so they can optimize verified useful work per intervention. Tracks R-IOC-BUDGET[^insp-ioc-08].
implementation: `GeneratorCostCounters` on `GeneratorRunRecord` exposed via `inspect().cost` (local_steps, guidance_yields, resumes, rejected_resumes).
validation: Harness `durable_graph_generator` op `durable_cost_budget`. Hard expects guidance_yields and resumes matching the scripted cycle.
